request.description:
The boot runs configure_caches, provision_toolchain and worker_repo_setup. The restore's setup entry (run_setup_entry) runs only configure_caches and worker_repo_setup. A repository that declares a toolchain the image lacks (mise.toml, .tool-versions) gets it at boot, but not after a container loss, so tests on the restored tree fail.
evidence: image/worker.sh:1527-1541 vs :1460-1493; image/common.sh:1067

request.title: Restore's setup entry skips provision_toolchain; a restored box lacks mise tools
